flags.issue: Wording is 'any quarterly Observation Date, beginning on February 8, 2027' (not 'interim'), so the Final Valuation Date is treated as callable: 11 levels. If the verifier reads it as interim-only, drop to 10. Pricing-equivalent either way (call at 100% vs. par+coupon at maturity).
Used the stated cash coupon $0.2773/$10 = 2.773%. Filing also states 2.7725% per quarter (11.09%/4, line 683). Verifier to choose convention.
Names written as in cover table with spaced '®' ('Russell 2000 ® Index'); line breaks in source split the ® symbol.
Filing gives 'Settlement Date' (2026-08-12), no explicit 'Issue Date' label.
First observation/payment dates are marked '*' (non-callable footnote); all dates subject to postponement, scheduled dates used.

scope.reason: Worst-of (lesser performing) contingent-coupon autocallable on two equity price-return indices (RTY, SPX); discrete quarterly autocall from obs #2 at 100%; non-memory coupon with 75% barrier; European (final valuation date only) 75% downside threshold with 1:1 loss; not buffered.
